messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Paging @oncall-sre — SLO alert: streaming p99 latency > 10s for SSE responses in eu-west-1. Spike started ~5m ago. Investigate.
Alex: I'm on it, digging into proxy metrics and connection traces.
Maria: Customer-facing errors? Any 5xxs or just slow chunks?
Alex: Mostly stalled chunks. No surge in 5xx. p95 up to 1.2s, p99 jumping to ~12s for long-running SSEs.
Tyler: I can pull the proxy logs. Hypothesis: keepalive / write buffer backed up on proxy -> slow flush to client.
Priya: Any recent deploys to streaming-proxy or routing?
Alex: Small TLS cert rotation + proxy rev on eu-west-1 around 10m before spike. Could be related.
PDBot: #pagerduty-incident opened -> PD-3981, severity: page, ETA 30m -> oncall: Alex.
Maria: Customer impact: a subset of streaming sessions are stuck at initial chunks; some customers report UI freezing. Not all clients.
Tyler: Pulling proxy stats: active connections steady. But write_queue_depth on proxy nodes increased from 100->1200. Backpressure metric shows consumers blocked.
Alex: Reproducing locally with a slow client shows server flushes coalescing; proxy waits until buffer threshold before sending chunk. That matches.
Priya: Quick mitigation options: 1) reduce proxy chunk coalescing threshold, 2) roll back proxy rev, 3) force fallback route to dedicated streaming tier.
Maria: For customer comms we should say "intermittent live streaming stalls affecting chunk delivery; engineering investigating".
Alex: I'll attempt a config tweak first — reduce write coalesce timeout from 250ms -> 50ms on a canary proxy and observe. If that doesn't improve in 5m, roll back.
Tyler: Command I'm running on canary (eu-west-1-proxy-3):
```
sudo /opt/proxy/bin/proxyctl set --service streaming --write-coalesce-ms=50
sudo systemctl restart proxy-service
```
Alex: Canary applied. Observing metrics... write_queue_depth dropping, p99 improving on that node from 12s -> 1.8s within 60s.
Priya: Nice. Any side-effects? CPU up +5% on node, memory steady. No new errors.
Maria: Can we roll this to the rest of eu-west-1 proxy pool gradually? Need careful rollout to avoid flapping.
Tyler: I'll roll to two additional nodes to validate. Doing sequential 30s pause between nodes.
Alex: Rolling to the rest now. Watch for client reconnect churn.
PDBot: Noted. Customer status page draft: "Investigating - chunking latency impacting streaming sessions in EU region. Mitigation deployed to proxy nodes; monitoring for recovery." Maria to publish?
Maria: I'll post the status update with the mitigation note.
Tyler: After full rollout p99 across region dropped to 700-900ms, p95 ~180-220ms. No increase in 5xx.
Alex: Root cause theory: cert rotation triggered reconnections and transient slower client acks exposed a proxy coalescing heuristic that waited too long to flush small chunks when backpressure present. The write queue grew and amplified lag.
Priya: Follow-ups: 1) revert to original coalesce if CPU cost unacceptable (monitor), 2) add circuit-breaker that flushes on sustained queue growth, 3) postmortem with timeline.
Maria: Assigning postmortem owner: Alex. Will include customer impact list and what customers were on the affected proxy pool.
Alex: I'll open the postmortem and attach traces + the canary graphs.
PDBot: Paging: schedule handoff to next on-call in 45m.
Alex: Handoff plan: I'll stay on for 30m to validate stability, then hand to Priya. Priya, you'll take the remainder and own the postmortem edits.
Priya: Ack. I'll pick up at +30m. Anything else to escalate to SRE lead?
Maria: Product wants an ETA for root cause and customer list. Alex, include an initial impact table in the postmortem so we can brief CS.
Alex: Will do. Uploading logs and linking dashboards now: https://dashboards.redwood/internal/streams/eu-west-1?range=15m
Tyler: Added proxy node logs to the incident folder: s3://incidents/PD-3981/proxy-logs/
Maria: Status update published to status.redwood.com: "Mitigation deployed; clients recovering. We are monitoring and will provide a follow-up".
Priya: Taking over now for continued monitoring. Handoff: I'm watching p99 and write_queue_depth; notify me if p99 > 2s.
Alex: Thank you team — leaving the channel.
Priya: A few minutes in, metrics stable. We'll keep the reduced coalesce setting until postmortem decisions.
PDBot: Incident PD-3981 status -> acknowledgement recorded.
Maria: Preparing customer-facing summary for impacted accounts; will coordinate with Alex for technical details.
Priya: Handoff note for next on-call: mitigation applied (write-coalesce-ms=50), canary success -> full rollout, monitoring thresholds set, postmortem owner Alex.
Maria: Closing thread in 2h after postmortem created.
Priya: Closing for now — if anything flares, re-open PD-3981 and ping @oncall-sre.
